description: Thunderjet displayed on Havacılar Caddesi at Alemdağ Mahallesi in Çekmeköy, a street whose name means Aviators Street. No contributor has linked a serial or established whether the airframe is a straight-wing G or a swept-wing F, so both tail_number and variant are deliberately blank. spottingmode status preserved last updated 22 June 2015.
museum_name: Havacılar Caddesi F-84 Monument -- Çekmeköy, İstanbul
